_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The Slack panel offers an explicit webhook-only test and explains bot failures. The VM has two integrations named "slack-hook": a personal webhook and a team Slack bot whose help is {{HELP}}. A Slack test answers 422 "This is a Slack bot. This test only supports incoming webhooks." Call "sends" returns how many Slack tests the page has sent; call "last send" returns the JSON body of the last one ("none" before one). Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does; "named X" means an exact name match. "The modal" is ".integrations-modal". To "open the panel": press Control+k; ".command-palette-input" should be visible; fill it with "integration", click the first ".command-palette-item", and the modal should be visible. To "select" an integration N: click the first ".integrations-tabs button" (the list), then the ".integrations-name-btn" whose text starts with N followed by a space; ".integrations-detail-head strong" should then have exactly the text N. "The refresh button" is the modal's button named "Refresh"; "the Slack test button" is the button named "Test integration (webhook only)"; "the notify button" is the button named "Send test notification". To "close the modal": click the modal's button whose name contains "Close modal". To "start": navigate to /new, wait for the element with data-testid "message-input" to be visible, and open the panel. Perform the steps in order. 1. Start, and click the first ".integrations-name-btn". 2. The Slack test button should be enabled, and ".slack-access" should have exactly the text "For incoming webhooks only. Slack bots are not supported by this test." 3. Select the option with value "team:slack-hook" of "#slack-hook" (fill it with that value). The Slack test button should be enabled. 4. Click ".integrations-guide summary": ".integrations-guide pre" should have exactly the text {{HELP}}. 5. Call "sends": it must return "0". 6. Fill "#slack-message" with "Hello bot" and click the Slack test button. The element with role "alert" inside ".slack-integration" should have exactly the text "This is a Slack bot. This test only supports incoming webhooks." 7. Call "sends": it must return "1"; call "last send": it must return {"message":"Hello bot","name":"slack-hook","team":true}.
